description: Fetch a single relay packet by its connection serial number (conn_sn). Returns the packet data on success or a `{success:false, message}` shape if the packet isn't found.

chainId.description: REQUIRED: Intent-relay chain ID of the source chain (decimal string)

connSn.description: REQUIRED: Connection serial number identifying the packet within the tx, a non-negative integer as a decimal string (e.g. '7'; pass a fetched packet's `conn_sn` as a string).

format.description: Response format: 'json' for raw data or 'markdown' for formatted text

name: sodax_relay_get_packet
